name: Kindex Integration
description: Optional Kindex integration module with graceful degradation. Manages lazy initialization of a Kindex Store singleton with memoized availability checking. Handles cases where kindex is not installed by catching exceptions during dynamic import.

functions.name: is_available
functions.description: Checks if Kindex is available, lazily initializing the store on first call. Uses module-level _checked flag to memoize the result and avoid repeated initialization attempts.
postconditions: _checked is set to True after first invocation
Returns True if _store was successfully initialized
Returns False if _store initialization failed or was never attempted
side_effects: Mutates global _checked to True on first call

functions.name: _init_store
functions.description: Attempts to dynamically import kindex modules and initialize a Store singleton. Catches all exceptions and logs them at debug level, returning False on any failure. This enables graceful degradation when kindex is not installed.

error_cases.name: kindex_import_failure
error_cases.condition: kindex.config or kindex.store cannot be imported

error_data.handling: caught, logged at debug level, returns False
caught, logged at debug level, returns False

postconditions: Returns True if Store was successfully created and assigned to _store
Returns False if any exception occurred during import or initialization
_store is set to Store(config) on success, unchanged on failure

structured_side_effects.description: Assigns Store instance to global _store on success
Logs exception details when kindex is unavailable

functions.name: close
functions.description: Closes the Kindex store if initialized and resets module state to uninitialized. Allows re-initialization on subsequent is_available() calls.
postconditions: If _store was not None before call, _store.close() was invoked

structured_side_effects.description: Calls close() method if present, then sets to None
Resets to False to allow re-initialization

invariants: _checked indicates whether initialization has been attempted
_store is None when kindex is unavailable or close() has been called
_store contains Store instance when kindex initialization succeeded
Once _checked is True, is_available() will not re-attempt initialization unless close() is called

data_access.rationale: Module maintains singleton state in module-level globals for lazy initialization pattern

side_effects.rationale: Manages lazy-initialized singleton Store instance with memoization flag

authority.rationale: Owns the integration point between transmogrifier and optional kindex dependency, managing initialization lifecycle
